abstract_findings.finding: Systems analyses of meningococcal polysaccharide and conjugate vaccines identified distinct transcriptional signatures of antibody responses for different vaccine classes.
The identified transcription modules provided insights into primary viral responses.
The identified transcription modules provided insights into protein recall responses.
The identified transcription modules provided insights into anti-polysaccharide responses.
Early transcriptional programs orchestrating vaccine immunity in humans were illuminated.
Integrative network modeling demonstrated power for analyzing vaccine immunity.
